title.zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5.2 与 Mythos 5.2
title.en: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2

summary.zh: Anthropic 推出 Fable 5.2 与 Mythos 5.2，称其为迄今最强模型，分为免费版和仅限已验证机构的版本；官方称编码、推理与视觉均有提升，输出速度快于 5.1，并已上线 Amazon Bedrock。
summary.en: Anthropic released Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, its most powerful models so far, in a freely available version and one for verified organizations. It cites gains in coding, reasoning and vision, faster output than 5.1, and availability on Amazon Bedrock.

why.zh: 前沿模型代际更新，直接影响开发者模型选择。
why.en: A frontier model refresh that affects developers' model choices.

sources.title: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 cement Anthropic's AI lead just before its IPO
Anthropic releases new Mythos and Fable models amid RSI concerns
Anthropic launches new Claude Fable and Mythos 5.2 models

title.zh: Claude Code「不再询问」设置导致大量密钥泄露到 GitHub
title.en: Claude Code "do not ask again" setting is leaking secrets on GitHub

summary.zh: Ars Technica 报道，Claude Code 的「不再询问」提示导致密码、API 密钥等被写入配置文件并公开在 GitHub 上。
summary.en: Ars Technica reports that Claude Code's "do not ask again" prompt leads to passwords and API keys ending up in settings files shared on GitHub.

why.zh: 使用该工具的开发者应检查并清理已提交的配置文件。
why.en: Developers using the tool should check and clean committed settings files.

sources.title: Claude Code is accidentally exposing secrets all over GitHub

title.zh: Meta 发布轻量智能体模型 Muse Ember
title.en: Meta launches lightweight agent model Muse Ember

summary.zh: Meta 推出最小最高效的模型 Muse Ember，面向工具调用、路由和数据提取等重复性智能体任务，输入价格每百万 token 10 美分；Meta 称其性价比高于 Claude Haiku 5.5 和 GPT-6 Luna，但编程能力较弱。
summary.en: Meta introduced Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient model, built for repetitive agent work like tool calls, routing and extraction, at 10 cents per million input tokens. Meta claims better intelligence per dollar than Claude Haiku 5.5 or GPT-6 Luna, but it is weaker at programming.

why.zh: 低价小模型为大规模智能体降本提供新选项。
why.en: A cheap small model gives agent builders a new cost option.

sources.title: Meta launches Muse Ember, a small AI model built for the repetitive work agents actually do
Meta releases Muse Ember, a new lightweight model for agent execution

title.zh: 据报道 Anthropic 将推进 IPO，本周确定估值区间
title.en: Anthropic reportedly moving ahead with IPO, valuation range due this week

summary.zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，Anthropic 预计本周确定估值区间并推进上市计划。
summary.en: The Wall Street Journal reports Anthropic is expected to set its valuation range this week as it moves forward with IPO plans.

why.zh: 头部 AI 公司上市将影响行业融资与估值格局。
why.en: A top AI lab going public would shape sector funding and valuations.

sources.title: Anthropic reportedly plans to move forward with IPO plans

title.zh: 英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋承认婚外情，董事会调查其与疑似中国间谍的关系
title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admits affair; board probes ties to suspected Chinese informant

summary.zh: 黄仁勋在内部备忘录中承认与 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 有婚外情，美国情报部门将其列为疑似中国线人；英伟达董事会已启动独立调查，股价一度下跌逾 4%，并可能削弱其反对收紧芯片出口管制的游说。
summary.en: Huang admitted in a memo to an affair with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, whom US intelligence classifies as a suspected Chinese informant. Nvidia's board opened an independent investigation, the stock fell over 4%, and his lobbying against tighter chip export controls may be weakened.

why.zh: 关系到全球 AI 算力龙头的治理与对华芯片政策。
why.en: It bears on the governance of the leading AI chip maker and on China chip policy.

sources.title: Everything we know so far about the Nvidia spy scandal targeting CEO Jensen Huang
Nvidia CEO's affair becomes a national security problem
Nvidia will investigate CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with possible Chinese spy
Nvidia espionage scandal weakens Huang's lobby against tighter AI chip export controls
Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy puts Nvidia’s China ambitions under scrutiny

title.zh: 谷歌扩充 TPU 8 系列，一年内推出四个变体
title.en: Google expands TPU 8 family, four variants in a year

summary.zh: 谷歌新增 TPU 8tx（处理中保持数据加密）和 TPU 8i Max（单封装双芯片，算力与内存翻倍），外部客户已近 100 家，定位为英伟达 GPU 的替代。
summary.en: Google added TPU 8tx, which keeps data encrypted during processing, and TPU 8i Max, which doubles compute and memory with two chips per package. Nearly 100 external customers are on board as Google positions TPUs against Nvidia GPUs.

why.zh: AI 算力供给格局出现更多自研芯片选择。
why.en: More in-house chip choices change the AI compute landscape.

sources.title: Google ships four TPU variants in one year as it ramps up competition with Nvidia

title.zh: 字节 Seedream 5.5 主打 100 轮不偏色的稳定图像编辑
title.en: ByteDance Seedream 5.5 targets 100 rounds of drift-free image editing

summary.zh: 字节 Seed 发布图像模型 Seedream 5.5，支持最多 100 轮稳定的多轮编辑、原生 RGBA 透明背景输出，称真实感优于 GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst，Pro 版计划推出。
summary.en: ByteDance Seed introduced Seedream 5.5, supporting stable editing over up to 100 iterations and native RGBA transparent output, and claims higher realism than GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst. A Pro version is planned.

why.zh: 多轮编辑稳定性是专业图像工作流的关键短板。
why.en: Multi-pass stability is a key gap for professional image workflows.

sources.title: Bytedance's Seedream 5.5 promises pixel-stable image editing across 100 rounds without color drift

title.zh: Karpathy 用 Claude 一个周末做出精选视频平台
title.en: Karpathy builds a curated video platform in a weekend with Claude

summary.zh: Karpathy 用 Claude Opus 5.5 筛选 4300 万条 Hacker News 评论，得到 6454 个精选视频，称效果优于 YouTube 推荐。
summary.en: Karpathy used Claude Opus 5.5 to filter 43 million Hacker News comments into 6,454 curated videos, saying it beats YouTube's recommendations.

why.zh: 展示了个人借助大模型快速搭建大规模内容策展产品的可能。
why.en: Shows how one person can build large-scale curation with an LLM in days.

sources.title: Andrej Karpathy built a curated video platform in a weekend using Claude and 20 years of Hacker News

title.zh: 「苦涩的教训」提出者 Sutton：单靠算力不足以通向智能
title.en: Sutton: raw compute alone is not enough for intelligence

summary.zh: 图灵奖得主 Sutton 重申需要全新的学习方法，前 OpenAI 研究员 Tworek 也称盲目扩展 Transformer 误导了一代研究者，一批初创公司正押注这一空白。
summary.en: Turing Award winner Richard Sutton says fundamentally new learning methods are needed; ex-OpenAI researcher Tworek agrees that blind transformer scaling misled a generation, and startups are betting on the gap.

why.zh: 反映业界对继续堆算力路线的反思。
why.en: Signals growing doubt about the pure scaling path.

sources.title: The inventor of the bitter lesson has a bitter lesson for LLM scaling enthusiasts

title.zh: 腾讯 AI 首席科学家：AI 生物武器将至，但封闭模型并非答案
title.en: Tencent AI chief: AI bioweapons are coming, but closing models is not the answer

summary.zh: 腾讯首席 AI 科学家姚顺雨称开源模型的安全过滤可被「消融」去除，而闭源模型又过度拦截；腾讯即将发布的开源模型 Hy4 将直接在训练数据中过滤危险黑客知识。
summary.en: Tencent chief AI scientist Vinces Yao Shunyu says open-model safety filters can be stripped by abliteration while closed models over-block; Tencent's upcoming open-weight Hy4 will filter dangerous hacking knowledge from training data.

why.zh: 提出开源与闭源之间的安全折中思路。
why.en: Proposes a middle path on open versus closed model safety.

sources.title: Tencent's AI chief says AI bioweapons are coming, but closing off models isn't the answer
